import csv, collections
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv')))
print(len(rows))
psy=[r for r in rows if r['project'] in ('rpp','ml1','ml3')]
print('psy',len(psy))
print('seniority.o',collections.Counter(r['seniority.o'] for r in psy))
print('seniority.r',collections.Counter(r['seniority.r'] for r in psy))
prof_o=sum(1 for r in psy if r['seniority.o']=='Professor')
print('prof.o frac',prof_o/len(psy),prof_o)
prof_r=sum(1 for r in psy if r['seniority.r']=='Professor')
print('prof.r frac',prof_r/len(psy))
jr=[r for r in psy if r['seniority.r'] in ('Assistant','Assistant Professor')]
print('junior r (assist only)',len(jr)/len(psy),len(jr))
jr2=[r for r in psy if r['seniority.r'] in ('Assistant','Assistant Professor','Associate Professor')]
print('junior r incl assoc',len(jr2)/len(psy),len(jr2))
rep=[r for r in psy if r['replicated'].strip() in ('1','1.0')]
print('replicated psy n',len(rep))
print('rep seniority.r',collections.Counter(r['seniority.r'] for r in rep))
print('rep seniority.o',collections.Counter(r['seniority.o'] for r in rep))
jrr=[r for r in rep if r['seniority.r'] in ('Assistant','Assistant Professor')]
print('junior r among replicated',len(jrr)/len(rep),len(jrr))
prof_or=[r for r in rep if r['seniority.o']=='Professor']
print('prof o among replicated',len(prof_or)/len(rep))
# per project
for p in ('rpp','ml1','ml3'):
    sub=[r for r in psy if r['project']==p]
    print(p,len(sub),collections.Counter(r['seniority.r'] for r in sub),collections.Counter(r['seniority.o'] for r in sub))

# Also per-discipline (Social/Cognitive)
for d in ('Social','Cognitive'):
    sub=[r for r in rows if r['discipline']==d]
    j=[r for r in sub if r['seniority.r'] in ('Assistant','Assistant Professor')]
    print(d,len(sub),'junior.r',len(j)/len(sub),'prof.o',sum(1 for r in sub if r['seniority.o']=='Professor')/len(sub))
